units.source_text: 然后就那么光着膀子，抱起篮子走进了旁边的女澡堂。

en.t: Then, still bare-chested, he picked up the basket and went into the women's bath next door.

units.source_text: 女子当然是装成夫妻的样子跟了上去。

en.t: Naturally, the woman followed along as if they were husband and wife.

units.source_text: 岛村默默地头也不回就跳进了温泉。

en.t: Without a word and without looking back, Shimamura jumped into the hot spring.

units.source_text: 他放心了，正要放声大笑，又急忙把嘴凑到泉口，胡乱地漱了漱口。

en.t: Relieved, he was just about to burst out laughing, but quickly put his mouth to the hot water spout and rinsed it roughly.
